metadata.case_name: YUNG WUN v. KUM SHING (K.F.) CONSTRUCTION CO LTD AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_before: labourer (employed by the 2nd defendant at the 1st defendants building site)

injuries.description: head injury due to contusion by a falling wooden block
source: She had a history of head injury due to contusion by a falling wooden block.
injuries.icd_description: Contusion of other or unspecified sites of head

injuries.description: clinically minor stroke after head injury
source: An MRI scan dated 7 September 2001 shows her as having a clinically minor stroke after head injury.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of intracranial vessels of head

source: She also sustained neck and right shoulder injury
The diagnosis was of sprained neck injury, which was treated conservatively and gradually approved with physiotherapy.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of cervical spine

source: She also sustained neck and right shoulder injury
erythema and tiny abrasions on the right shoulder.
injuries.icd_description: Abrasion of shoulder or upper arm

injuries.description: left shoulder lesion, probably post-traumatic frozen shoulder
source: left shoulder stiffness and pain, left lower neck pain and right clavicle pain. The left shoulder lesion was probably post-traumatic frozen shoulder with impaired rotation and abduction.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the shoulder or upper arm

injuries.description: minor contusion of the cervical spine and left shoulder
source: Dr Chun diagnosed a minor contusion of the cervical spine and left shoulder.

injuries.description: right sided weakness from the right L1 dermatome downwards / right hemiplegia
source: Then on 2 September 2001 Madam Yung was found to have right sided weakness from the right L1 dermatome downwards.
she was presenting with ... right hemiplegia
injuries.icd_description: Brown-Sequard syndrome of lumbar spinal cord

injuries.description: organic mood disorder and organic personality disorder (psychiatric diagnoses)
source: She was differentially diagnosed as having organic mood disorder and organic personality disorder, and was treated with antidepressants and mood stabilisers, but her drug compliance was not satisfactory.
Dr Chan said that Madam Yung probably also had a postconcussional syndrome

manifestations.description: right sided weakness from the right L1 dermatome downwards.
mild grade mental deterioration in intellectual functioning, moderate to severe antegrade memory impairment and borderline to impaired mental set shifting and abstract reasoning.
global cognitive deficits / severe global cognitive dysfunction
spasms in the right fingers and toes (reported history)
ankle oedema (as presented to Dr Chan)
right hand oedema (noted by Dr Singer in March 2005)
giddiness and proneness to vasovagal attacks
episodes of self-harm by cutting her wrists
reduced range of motion / impaired rotation and abduction of the left shoulder (frozen shoulder)
